name: Nessus Sphinx
desc: Nessus Sphinx (Amphion floridensis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Amphion floridensis, the Nessus sphinx, is a day-flying moth of the family Sphingidae. The species was described by Pieter Cramer in 1777, and renamed in 1920.
